arxiv-2011-10548.title: Bubble deformation by a turbulent flow
arxiv-2011-10548.creator: Stéphane Perrard 1,2, Aliénor Rivière 1,2, Wouter Mostert 1, Luc Deike 1,3
arxiv-2011-10548.description: Abstract We investigate the modes of deformation of an initially spherical bubble immersed in a homogeneous and isotropic turbulent background flow. We perform direct numerical simulations of the two-phase incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, considering a low-density bubble in the high density turbulent flow at various Weber number (the ratio of turbulent and surface tension forces) using the air-water density ratio.

arxiv-2104-02777.title: Comment on “Fast-slow mode coupling instability for coasting beams in the presence of detuning impedance”
arxiv-2104-02777.creator: Alexey Burov, Valeri Lebedev
arxiv-2104-02777.description: Abstract In this comment we show untenability of key points of the recent article of N. Biancacci, E. Metral and M. Migliorati [Phys. Rev. Accel. Beams 23, 124402 (2020)], hereafter the Article and the Authors. Specifically, the main Eqs. (23), suggested to describe mode coupling, are shown to be unacceptable even as an approximation.

arxiv-2204-07261.title: Convergence and Regularization Properties of Gradient Descent for Deep Residual Networks Alain Rossier’s research was supported through EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Mathematics of Random Systems: Analysis, Modelling and Simulation (EP/S023925/1).
arxiv-2204-07261.creator: Rama Cont, Alain Rossier, Renyuan Xu
arxiv-2204-07261.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rama Cont, Alain Rossier, Renyuan Xu. We prove linear convergence of gradient descent to a global optimum for the training of deep residual networks with constant layer width and smooth activation function. We show that if the trained weights, as a function of the layer index, admit a scaling limit as the depth increases, then the limit has finite p − p- variation with p = 2 p=2 .

arxiv-2204-08295.title: Ill-posedness for the stationary Navier-Stokes equations in critical Besov spaces
arxiv-2204-08295.creator: Jinlu Li, Yanghai Yu, Weipeng Zhu
arxiv-2204-08295.description: Abstract Abstract: This paper presents some progress toward an open question which proposed by Tsurumi (Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 234:2, 2019): whether or not the stationary Navier-Stokes equations in \mathbb{R}^{d} is well-posed from \dot{B}_{p,q}^{-2} to \mathbb{P}\dot{B}_{p,q}^{0} with p=d and 1\leq q\leq 2 .

arxiv-2212-07376.description: Abstract Linux container technologies such as Docker [ 1 ] and Singularity [ 2 ] offer encapsulated environments for easy execution of software. In high performance computing, this is especially important for evolving and complex software stacks with conflicting dependencies that must co-exist.

arxiv-2306-03932.title: Q: How to Specialize Large Vision-Language Models to Data-Scarce VQA Tasks? A: Self-Train on Unlabeled Images!
arxiv-2306-03932.creator: Zaid Khan Vijay Kumar BG Samuel Schulter Xiang Yu Yun Fu Manmohan Chandraker
arxiv-2306-03932.description: Abstract Finetuning a large vision language model (VLM) on a target dataset after large scale pretraining is a dominant paradigm in visual question answering (VQA). Datasets for specialized tasks such as knowledge-based VQA or VQA in non natural-image domains are orders of magnitude smaller than those for general-purpose VQA.

arxiv-2402-16762.title: The influence of the vorticity-scalar correlation on mixing
arxiv-2402-16762.creator: Xi–Yuan Yin 1 , Wesley Agoua 1 , Tong Wu 1,2 , Wouter J.T. Bos 1
arxiv-2402-16762.description: Abstract We investigate the role of the correlation between a scalar quantity and the vorticity in two-dimensional mixing at infinite Péclet number. We assess, using a diffusivity independent mixing-norm, the dynamics of both Galerkin-truncated ensembles and freely evolving two-dimensional scalar mixing. Both statistical mechanics and numerical experiments show how the mixing-rate is attenuated when vorticity and scalar are initially correlated.

arxiv-2503-09847.title: Stabilizing steady-state properties of open quantum systems with parameter engineering
arxiv-2503-09847.creator: Koray Aydoğan, Anthony W. Schlimgen, Kade Head-Marsden
arxiv-2503-09847.description: Abstract Realistic quantum systems are affected by environmental loss, which is often seen as detrimental for applications in quantum technologies. Alternatively, weak coupling to an environment can aid in stabilizing highly entangled and mixed states, but determining optimal system-environment parameters can be challenging.

arxiv-2503-23414.title: From Content Creation to Citation Inflation: A GenAI Case Study
arxiv-2503-23414.creator: Haitham S. Al-Sinani, Chris J. Mitchell
arxiv-2503-23414.description: Abstract This paper investigates the presence and impact of questionable, AI-generated academic papers on widely used preprint repositories, with a focus on their role in citation manipulation. Motivated by suspicious patterns observed in publications related to our ongoing research on GenAI-enhanced cybersecurity, we identify clusters of questionable papers and profiles.

arxiv-2510-06055.title: Construction of optimal tests for symmetry on the torus and their quantitative error bounds
arxiv-2510-06055.creator: Andreas Anastasiou, Christophe Ley, Sophia Loizidou
arxiv-2510-06055.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop optimal tests for symmetry on the hyper-dimensional torus, leveraging Le Cam’s methodology. We address both scenarios where the center of symmetry is known and where it is unknown. These tests are not only valid under a given parametric hypothesis but also under a very broad class of symmetric distributions.

britannica-1911-marius-gaius.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-marius-gaius.description: Article 'Marius, Gaius' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. descent, the son of a small farmer of Cereatae (mod. Casamare, “home of Marius”) near Arpinum. He served first in Spain under the great Scipio Africanus, and rose from the ranks to be an officer. In 119 as tribune he proposed a law intended to limit the influence of the nobles at elections. This brought him into conflict with the aristocratic party, who prevented him from obtaining the aedileship.

pmc-10609847.title: Patient-Derived Cellular Models for Polytarget Precision Medicine in Pantothenate Kinase-Associated Neurodegeneration
pmc-10609847.creator: Mónica Álvarez-Córdoba, Marta Talaverón-Rey, Suleva Povea-Cabello, Paula Cilleros-Holgado, David Gómez-Fernández, Rocío Piñero-Pérez, Diana Reche-López, Manuel Munuera-Cabeza, Alejandra Suárez-Carrillo, Ana Romero-González, Jose Manuel Romero-Domínguez, Alejandra López-Cabrera, José Ángel Armengol,
pmc-10609847.description: The term neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation (NBIA) brings together a broad set of progressive and disabling neurological genetic disorders in which iron is deposited preferentially in certain areas of the brain. Among NBIA disorders, the most frequent subtype is pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration (PKAN) caused by pathologic variants in the PANK2 gene codifying the enzyme pantothenate kinase 2 (PANK2).

pmc-11433931.title: Enhancing Wastewater Treatment with Aerobic Granular Sludge: Impacts of Tetracycline Pressure on Microbial Dynamics and Structural Stability
pmc-11433931.creator: Shengyan Zheng, Bichen Lou, Zhonghui Yang, Dong Ou, Ning Ai, Alexander Machado Cardoso
pmc-11433931.description: This study evaluated the efficiency of aerobic granular sludge (AGS) technology in treating wastewater contaminated with tetracycline (TC), a common antibiotic. AGS was cultivated under a TC pressure gradient ranging from 5 mg/L to 15 mg/L and compared with conventional wastewater conditions.

pmc-11456066.title: Changes in Early-Phase Clinical Trials in China During 2013–2022: A Review
pmc-11456066.creator: Jianxiong Zhang, Peng Zhang, Haixue Wang, Ruihua Dong
pmc-11456066.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Clinical trials on innovative drugs in China have witnessed a stage of rapid development in recent years. The introduction of a number of government policies has stimulated enthusiasm for research and development in the pharmaceutical industry. We analyzed the data of the early-phase clinical trials registered in the Chinese Center for Drug Evaluation (CDE) from September 6, 2013, to December 31, 2022.

pmc-12552343.title: Is splenectomy one of the contributory factors to pulmonary hypertension? An analysis of splenectomized hemolytic anemia and immune thrombocytopenia patients
pmc-12552343.creator: Zeliha Birsin, Ayşe Salihoğlu, Kardelen Ohtaroğlu Tokdil, Betül Zehra Pirdal, Seçkin Bilgiç, Burçak Kılıçkıran Avcı, Deniz Özmen, Ahmet Emre Eşkazan, Muhlis Cem Ar, Zafer Başlar, Tuğrul Elverdi
pmc-12552343.description: The development of pulmonary hypertension (PH) after splenectomy is one of the recently controversial issues. This study aims to investigate whether splenectomy itself is an independent risk factor for the development of PH or if the primary contributor to PH development is the underlying condition that necessitated splenectomy. This study was conducted prospectively.

pmc-12590712.title: Workplace relational injustice and authoritarian treatment as risk factors for sexual harassment at a large Swedish university: results from a cross-sectional study
pmc-12590712.creator: Frida Pilgaard, Anette Agardh, Per-Olof Östergren, Jack Palmieri, Benedict Oppong Asamoah
pmc-12590712.description: BackgroundWorkplace sexual harassment remains a persistent issue in Sweden. Research about organisational antecedents has been criticised for being limited in scope, possibly overlooking contextual factors relevant for the occurrence of sexual harassment. This study examined two factors capturing aspects of organisational climate, perceived relational justice and authoritarian treatment, and their association to workplace sexual harassment in a Swedish university setting.

pmc-13233463.title: Upfront triple combination therapy with selexipag: insights from a real world cohort in Chinese patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension
pmc-13233463.creator: Xiaopei Cui, Xiaoyu Hu, Xiaoteng Qin, Haijun Li, Xia Xu, Hui Liu, Qiushang Ji
pmc-13233463.description: AimSelexipag has demonstrated safety and efficacy in the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). However, the strategy of triple therapy involving selexipag and its impact on right heart remodeling requires further clarification in Chinese patients with PAH.Methods and resultsThis investigation was conducted as a single-center, retrospective study.

pmc-13632068.title: Accuracy of large language models in the Turkish dental specialization examination (DUS): a multidimensional evaluation across disciplines and question formats
pmc-13632068.creator: Fatih Karaaslan, Muhammed Halil Yilan, Merve Tirimoğulları
pmc-13632068.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the performance of contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs) on the clinical sciences component of the Turkish Dental Specialization Examination (DUS) by comparing their accuracy across disciplines, examination years, and question types.MethodsThe source dataset contained 1,040 scheduled clinical-science questions from the official DUS examinations (2012/1–2021).

pmc-13676204.title: Effect of animation-based edutainment compared with pamphlet-based education on hand hygiene and HAI prevention among surgical patients: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-13676204.creator: Raziyeh Ghafouri, Zahra Azizi, Zeinab Asghari
pmc-13676204.description: SummaryBackgroundHealthcare-associated infections (HAIs) are among the most common and serious complications in healthcare settings. Engaging patients in infection prevention through effective educational interventions is a key strategy for reducing the risk of HAIs. This study aimed to compare the effects of animation-based edutainment and pamphlet-based education on hand hygiene practices and HAI prevention among surgical patients.
